note: This is the binding 16-item list. The older MASTER_TASKS.json 16 areas are a different command and were not deleted.

items.name: Textile AI
items.requirement: Textile homepage, slides, video, optional measurements/photo, age/profession outfits, virtual try-on, angles, privacy.
items.previousCommandEvidence: None as a product. textile_ai roster + cat-01 tree only.
items.existingImplementation: data/buzzard_categories.json cat-01; server/lib/pusat/council.js textile_ai; lib/navigation/home-config.ts TEXTIL campaign.
items.missingFunctionality: Hub page, media, measurements, try-on, privacy box.
items.securityReview: Photos/measurements are personal data; opt-in required.

items.name: AB-27 cargo and logistics
items.requirement: 27-country carriers, compare rates/SLA, B2B/retail, API/XML/CSV/webhook, label, track, address, returns, Pusat.
items.missingFunctionality: Live carrier APIs and verified prices.

items.name: Sanctions and trade compliance
items.requirement: EU/UN/DE sources; product, origin, transit, buyer, supplier, end user, dual-use; hold + human review.
items.missingFunctionality: Live lists, dual-use engine, entity matching.
items.securityReview: False negative is worse than hold. Uncertainty waits for a human.

items.name: Privacy and country file protection
items.requirement: 27 isolated country files; verify authority; legal basis; phishing/fake-document defense; binding orders not blocked.
items.missingFunctionality: Per-country stores, authority verification, phishing engine.

items.name: 26-country tax pools and payment ban
items.requirement: Separate pools for 26 non-DE countries; 25% of net income reserve; no Buzzard tax-payment instrument there; DE prior approval rule kept.
items.previousCommandEvidence: AB27 VAT snapshot 27 rates; sales locked.
items.missingFunctionality: Pool ledgers; 25% reserve posting; explicit non-DE payout deny.
items.securityReview: No live payouts. payTax always denied.

items.name: AB-27 national and special days
items.requirement: Verified calendars; homepage banner/slide/video in local language; schedule, preview, edit, close, copyright.
items.previousCommandEvidence: None. bz.41 is a product category, not a calendar.
items.securityReview: Copyright check before publish. Publish blocked.

items.name: AB-27 Tax Connect
items.requirement: Official tax/public channels; filings, debt, refunds, correspondence archive. No fake connection. Money transfer separate.

items.name: Doğu Bey research
items.requirement: Take category-AI requests, sourced research, return to requester, escalate needs to Pusat. Real workflow tests.
items.previousCommandEvidence: CODE_READY in-process; audit asked independent verify.

items.name: 24/7 phone AI and voice council
items.requirement: SIP, STT, TTS, routing, conference, speaker/role, emergency reach + fallback notify.
items.securityReview: No call recording without legal basis.

items.name: Secure council messaging
items.requirement: Keep HMAC; do not call it E2E. Strong auth, roles, real E2E, backup, device; Esat review required.
items.missingFunctionality: Esat gate; device identity; production secret required.
items.securityReview: HMAC is integrity only. Production lock uses env secret only.

items.name: Laptop and local device security
items.requirement: BitLocker, TPM, Secure Boot, MFA, PIN, offline recovery, remote lock, loss procedure. Verify device support. No silent wipe.
items.missingFunctionality: OS attestation; BitLocker-named runbook; loss drill.
items.securityReview: Never auto-destroy recovery keys. completeClaim stays false.

items.name: Application and acceptance tests
items.requirement: Per-item unit, integration, security, live verification recorded separately. Do not mark complete on failed tests.
items.previousCommandEvidence: Partial ecosystem tests; CI 2 flakes historically.

items.name: Independent capabilities (no Claude)
items.requirement: No Claude/Claude Code integration. Rebuild useful general skills in Buzzard-owned code. Respect IP.
items.missingFunctionality: Owned skill library beyond forbid gate.

items.name: Cursor continuous maintenance
items.requirement: Detect/fix, security updates, deps, test, docs. Isolated workspaces. Verify Cursor limits.

items.name: Internal AI privacy and egress
items.requirement: Default egress off; firewall, allowlist, encryption, DLP, access, audit. Prove unauthorized external AI blocked.
items.securityReview: Denied destinations never reach fetch. Live firewall still unproven.

items.name: Business continuity and DR
items.requirement: Finish 3-2-1-1-0; local+offsite verify; real immutable; clean restore; integrity; RPO/RTO; ransomware/loss/region drills; Esat notify. Backup ≠ recovery.
items.previousCommandEvidence: Local prove COMPLETE; offsite BLOCKED; chmod 444 not WORM.
